old_problem: Device0/OAM/BDF and block0 mapping, numeric amdgpuras semantics, canonical secure Redfish endpoint, CPER attribution/decoder and fatal-error recovery are project/OEM-specific.
disposition_reason: ED-16 requires approved injection, isolation and Recovery. The standard CPER concept does not authorize AMD numeric targets or guarantee the OEM Dump endpoint/schema. PASS needs a proven GPU/OAM mapping, exactly one new attributable attachment and field-level decode; the known malformed example endpoint cannot be used.
decision_basis: Read all18 XLSX cells and history2562.
Preserved literal -d0 -b0 -s4 -t4 -m1, CPER before/after, attachment transfer, analyzer and exact decoded criteria.

test_case.test_name: AMD OOB UMC address/command-parity single-shot CPER
test_case.purpose: Prove one approved OOB UMC uncorrectable address/command-parity event creates exactly one attributable CPER with the expected component, type and severity.
required_package: Canonical secure Systems/UBB Dump entries/attachment endpoint and CA/auth
CPER collision/attribution and exact decoder schema
Dedicated idle GPU SUT, BMC/host OOB recovery and no-retry approval
test_case.test_command: Qualified operator records immutable GPU/BMC/CPER baseline, validates the secure endpoint, executes `amdgpuras -d 0 -b 0 -s 4 -t 4 -m 1` once, identifies the unique new entry, downloads and hash-verifies its attachment, decodes it with the pinned analyzer, validates OAM/UMC/ext4/AddressCommandParityErr/fatal fields, then verifies GPU/BMC/host recovery.
test_case.expected_result: One command succeeds and creates exactly one attributable CPER whose decoded OAM, UMC bank, ext4 type and fatal severity match the injection; no unrelated entry is selected and platform health/recovery is documented.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires approved target/tool/endpoint identity, one injection, unique CPER attribution, intact attachment/hash, exact decoded fields and completed recovery. Ambiguous index, wrong target/type/severity, missing attachment or instability fails/blocks.
safety_gate: Critical fatal-error authorization on dedicated idle GPU SUT.
Do not infer device/block mapping or use malformed/insecure endpoint.
Preserve full entry baseline; never assume max-index+1 under concurrency.
One injection only; no automatic retry, reset or recovery action.
expected_evidence: Complete CPER baseline and secure endpoint proof
Single injection transcript and unique new-entry diff
Attachment hash plus analyzer JSON with exact fields
GPU/BMC/host health, recovery and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: On ambiguous CPER, wrong GPU, fatal hang or lost connectivity, preserve BMC/host evidence and use only the approved OOB GPU/platform recovery. Do not inject or reset automatically; verify all accelerators before closure.
